acceptance: git diff --check passes and go test ./... passes.

Fixture tests for claude_code, codex, pi (and dot if its transcripts load skills) detect skill loads with correct name, path and turn, with no false positives for ordinary reads of non-skill markdown.
Sessions carry a filterable skills list; the dashboard shows skills per session and can filter sessions by a skill.
A documented, previewable backfill reports how many existing sessions per harness would gain skills; nothing applied to live namespaces by the worker.
